config.immersive_weathering.freezing_win: Night-only ambient gusts in every biome; cold thunder snowstorms can generate gusts day or night. No thermal system.

One sampled chance per ticking chunk per 20 ticks. Final chance is base + cold bonus * clamp((0.8 - base biome temperature)/1.3,0,1) + height bonus at/above the height + snowstorm bonus, clamped to 0-1.
Independent additive bonus, strongest at base biome temperature -0.5 or below, zero at 0.8 or above.
Height bonus starts at this Y (default 100); independent of the cold biome bonus.
Additional per-attempt probability at or above the altitude threshold.
Additional chance in cold thunder snowstorms, including daytime.
Maximum successful natural gust spawns per dimension per 20 game ticks. Zero stops natural spawning.
Maximum simultaneous natural gusts per dimension; ephemeral gusts are not saved.
Vanilla Slowness ticks per gust hit every five ticks; zero disables. IW default is 60 ticks, without temperature changes.
Zero-based effect amplifier: 0 means Slowness I.
Fire, candles, candle cakes, campfires and normal/soul torches. Torches stay in place and relight using flint and steel, fire charges or a lit torch. Requires mobGriefing.
Only surface water source blocks; uses existing IW thin-ice light/survival rules. No flowing/waterlogged replacement. Requires mobGriefing.
Per eligible empty underside cell in the 36-cell gust scan every five ticks. Any native valid support; respects disable_icicles and mobGriefing.
config.immersive_weathering.snowstorms.e: Cold snow-precipitation biomes during vanilla thunder, day or night. IW presentation yields to Immersive Storms without disabling IW gameplay.
config.immersive_weathering.snowstorms.d: Extra layers in the existing sampled accumulation path, capped by snow.column_cap and snowAccumulationHeight. Zero preserves ordinary thunder accumulation.
config.immersive_weathering.snowstorms.p: White windblown grains during cold thunder. Vanilla Minimal disables them; Decreased reduces trials.
Loaded-column scan radius, bounded to 0-32. Zero disables; default 20. Does not load chunks.
One column trial in this many. Higher is sparser; default 60.
config.immersive_weathering.snowstorms.f: Blend white weather/biome terrain fog without overriding fluid, blindness, darkness, stronger native fog or view distance.
Full-storm start distance; default 8, clamped to end and stronger native fog.
Full-storm end distance; default 48, never extends native view distance.
config.immersive_weathering.snowstorms.h: Hide clouds during strong cold thunder; independent of the fog toggle.
config.immersive_weathering.snowstorms.s: Intermittent existing IW wind audio near exposed storm surfaces. Weather volume applies. Presentation yields to installed Immersive Storms.

config.immersive_weathering.sand.host_mi: Share sand with fences and dead bushes
Regular and red sand layers share a dry cell with the 12 vanilla fences or a dead bush, in either placement order. No other plants, walls or modded hosts are registered.
config.immersive_weathering.sand.replace: Ordinary block items replace uncovered sand at any depth, including eight layers. Supported hosts retain the sand when mixing is enabled. Covered fences cannot be overwritten; covered dead bushes keep native replacement rules.
config.immersive_weathering.sand.rain_er: Actual rain gradually removes exposed sand one layer at a time without drops, restoring a covered host at zero. Both sandstorm biome tags are exempt; base biome temperature is not used.
Probability per random tick during actual rain. Default 0.125 (one in eight); zero disables erosion. Roofs, snowfall and sandstorm-tagged biomes preserve piles.
config.immersive_weathering.sandstorms.d: Add IW sand layers on exposed supported dry surfaces during desert/badlands rain. Independent of block growths and randomTickSpeed; no cauldron changes. All IW storm features yield to Scorchful when installed.
config.immersive_weathering.sandstorms.l: Maximum weather-deposited layers per pile (1-8), default eight for new configs. Also guards legacy sandy growth's pile output, not sandy-block conversion. Manual stacking and falling piles still reach eight. Existing configs retain their previous value. Never reduces existing piles or stacks another storm pile above a full one.
config.immersive_weathering.sandstorms.s: Applies a temporary movement-speed modifier outside. Camels and the sandstorm_slow_immune entity tag are exempt. Shelter, clear weather, immunity and disabling remove IW's modifier on the next entity tick.
Fraction of total movement speed removed. Default 0.3 is 30%; zero removes the modifier. No damage, thirst or temperature effects.
config.immersive_weathering.sandstorms.p: Show imported dust sprites. Respects vanilla particles: Minimal disables storm dust, Decreased halves the trial rate. No server gameplay change.
Scans (2 * range)^2 already-loaded columns per client tick. Default 20 scans 1600; zero disables. Maximum 32.
One dust trial per this many columns. Default 60. Higher numbers mean less dust.
config.immersive_weathering.sandstorms.f: Sand-colored, weather-blended terrain fog, including indoors. Preserves underwater/lava/powder-snow, blindness, darkness and stronger vanilla fog.
Full-storm terrain fog start in blocks. Default 16; clamped to end and vanilla fog.
Full-storm terrain fog end in blocks. Default 64; never extends vanilla view distance.
config.immersive_weathering.sandstorms.h: Hide clouds in storm biomes above 0.75 rain strength, including indoors. Independent of the fog toggle.
config.immersive_weathering.sandstorms.s: Intermittent wind from nine imported variants near storm surfaces. Uses Weather volume and Wind blows subtitles. Not a continuous loop; clears scheduling on world changes.
config.immersive_weathering.fire.entity_: Allow non-sun burning entities to ignite nearby flammable blocks. Requires doFireTick; non-player carriers also respect mobGriefing.
config.immersive_weathering.fire.torch_a: Successful direct melee with a main-hand torch or soul torch burns a living target for 4 seconds. Uses ordinary fire and consumes one item outside Creative.
config.immersive_weathering.fire.flammab: Grass blocks burn into dirt at the same position without drops. Requires doFireTick; other soils are unchanged.
config.immersive_weathering.fire.spread_: Ticks between staggered entity trials. One trial can ignite at most one cell.
Cube radius around the entity for dry, loaded air cells adjacent to flammable blocks.
config.immersive_weathering.fire.heat_ra: Cube radius for counting fire, soul fire, magma and lava. Torches and campfires do not count.
config.immersive_weathering.fire.heat_so: Stop counting heat sources at this limit.
config.immersive_weathering.fire.spread_: Probability per trial, not per cell. Default 0.02 is 2% before heat, temperature and projectile adjustments.
config.immersive_weathering.fire.project: Multiplier after the probability cap. Default 0.0625 gives projectiles one sixteenth the ordinary chance; zero disables them.
config.immersive_weathering.fire.heat_bo: Each counted source adds this amount to the heat multiplier, starting at 1.
config.immersive_weathering.fire.tempera: Multiplier bonus per biome base temperature above 0.8, clamped at temperature 2. No season integration.
config.immersive_weathering.fire.spread_: Maximum trial probability before the projectile reduction. Heat never bypasses this cap.
config.immersive_weathering.fire.thunder: Apply during thunder wherever ordinary fire can see the sky, including dry biomes and eternal-fire supports. Requires doFireTick. Does not extinguish burning entities, soul fire, torches or campfires.

Default 0.1 allows 10% of exposed fire's normal neighboring burn/spread attempts and scales exposed burning-entity environmental trials. Zero prevents attempts; one preserves normal attempts. Sheltered sources are unchanged.
Default 0.25 is a 25% chance per normal scheduled fire tick, roughly every 1.5-2 seconds. Zero disables extinguishing. Fire aging, scheduling and ordinary rain rules are otherwise preserved.

config.immersive_weathering.snow.host_mi: Keep snow in the same cell as supported dry plants, fences and walls. Existing covers remain removable when disabled.
config.immersive_weathering.snow.falling: Unsupported snow falls without moving its plant, fence or wall.
config.immersive_weathering.snow.replace: Replace plain snow or eligible covered plants at layers 1-7. Full covers and nonreplaceable hosts stay protected.
config.immersive_weathering.snow.accumul: Enable extra weather layers. Disabling this still allows vanilla's initial snowfall.
Allow extra snow during ordinary snowfall, not just thunderstorms.
config.immersive_weathering.snow.column_: Maximum weather layers in one cell (1-8). Gamerule 0 disables weather snow; 1 uses this cap; other positive values limit it.
